description: This file defines an interface 'ConfigurationProviderInterface' in the AWS SDK PHP library. It declares a static method for providing default configuration settings for AWS services.

classes.name: ConfigurationProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method for providing AWS SDK configuration providers, allowing customization of configuration sources.
